identitySignals: The agenda title names "Elevate Tutoring" exactly. A registered California nonprofit, Elevate Tutoring Inc. (EIN 45-1058760), has that name (GuideStar, Charity Navigator).
The nonprofit provides free STEM tutoring in K-12 schools. This matches a 2026-2027 services agreement for a middle school, run by the Chief Academic Officer.
GuideStar lists Oakland, Berkeley and San Jose among the places Elevate works. A 2025 Share the Spirit (East Bay Times) article describes Elevate tutoring an Oakland student.

No page found names OUSD or West Oakland Middle School as a client of Elevate Tutoring. The agenda gave no legal name, city or vendor name beyond the title, so the match rests on the name and service type.
research.notes: Medium confidence: nothing found links Elevate Tutoring Inc. to OUSD or West Oakland Middle School, and the agenda gave no legal name or city. A different Oakland nonprofit, Elevate Oakland (elevateoakland.org), turned up in search. It is not the same as Elevate Tutoring, but a reviewer should check the vendor against the actual contract. Phone, email and street address are null because the pages I fetched did not show them. The search snippets showed 2641 Thrasher Ln, San Jose, CA 95125 and 408-915-8874 on Charity Navigator. The CA entity number and SAM UEI were not checked in the Secretary of State or SAM.gov registries.

profile.summary: A nonprofit based in San Jose, California, that supports low-income and first-generation college students as paid, trained Tutor Fellows. The fellows give free STEM (science, technology, engineering and math) tutoring and mentoring to students in elementary, middle and high schools. It serves communities in the Bay Area, including Oakland.
